newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine monthly official crop projections.
newsitem.headline: Argentine monthly official crop projections.

text.p: Argentina's Agriculture Secretariat Wednesday cut its 1996/97 soybean crop production estimate to 11.0 million tonnes from 11.48 million tonnes.
It maintained its sunseed crop estimate at 5.0 million tonnes and its maize crop estimate at 14.5 million tonnes.
But it cut its wheat estimate to 15.98 million tonnes from 16.08 million tonnes, and reduced its total grains output estimate to 52.8 million tonnes from 53.4 million tonnes.
It said it expected wheat sowing for the coming 1997/98 season to fall by between 7.5 percent and 13 percent to 6.4-6.8 million hectares.
Farmers have already sown some 1.2 million hectares with wheat, the Secretariat said.
Area sown with brewers barley this coming season should expand by up to 11.0 percent to between 245,000 hectares and 270,000 hectares. Some 9,000 hectares of brewers barley have already been sown.
Total output of grains in 1996/97 was still a historical record for Argentina, 15.2 percent higher than the next most productive season, which was 1994/95.
Wheat output was also record. But production of soybeans was hit by a long spell of dry weather.
